column3: Close to the Hebrew; “will be lain with” is rendered “ravished,” and “will be plundered” “rifled.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the valley of my mountains” is rendered “My mountain valley,” and “all the holy ones” “all the saints.”
NKJV renders the difficult “there will not be light; the splendid ones will congeal (frost)” as “there will be no light; The lights will diminish”; the meaning is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “Yahweh will be one” is rendered as a quotation, “The LORD is one.”
Close to the Hebrew; “like the Arabah” is rendered “into a plain,” and “it will remain” “inhabited.”
Close to the Hebrew; “will rot” is rendered “shall dissolve.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to celebrate the festival of Tabernacles” is rendered “to keep the Feast of Tabernacles.”
Close to the Hebrew; the Hebrew “and not on them” is elliptical; NKJV supplies “they shall have no rain.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the punishment for the sin of Egypt” is rendered “the punishment of Egypt.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “shall be engraved.”
